aiTrade.title: AI TRADE
aiTrade.intro: Rent a trading bot that runs on TPIX cloud around the clock. Pick a strategy, set your own risk limits, and let it work — the same setup shows on web and in the app, because it is tied to one wallet.
aiTrade.headline: Let a bot trade for you 24/7
aiTrade.subheadline: Bots run on TPIX cloud, so nothing has to stay open on your machine. One wallet, shared between web and app.

aiTrade.connectHint: Bots and credits are tied directly to your wallet address

botWallet.title: Bot wallet
botWallet.pitch: A separate wallet the bot trades from in live mode — fund it here. Your own trading wallet is never touched, and withdrawals only go back to your wallet
botWallet.disabled: The bot wallet opens together with live mode once the system has been fully proven — every bot uses the demo portfolio for now
botWallet.createHint: We generate one BSC wallet bound to your verified address. Its key is double-encrypted and only usable when the bot sends orders
botWallet.depositHint: Send USDT (BSC) as the bot's capital plus a little {gas} for gas — BSC network only
botWallet.withdrawHint: The only destination is your verified wallet · sent within minutes · keep some BNB for gas

failure.owner_mismatch: Destination is not your wallet — nothing was sent, the funds are still in the bot wallet
failure.key_unreadable: The bot wallet key could not be opened — nothing was sent, the funds are still there and our team has been alerted
failure.insufficient_funds: Not enough balance or BNB for gas — nothing was sent, the funds are still in the bot wallet
failure.sign_failed: The transaction could not be prepared — nothing was sent, the funds are still in the bot wallet. You can request again
failure.reverted: The chain rejected the transaction — nothing was transferred (only gas was spent)
failure.nonce_consumed: This transaction was replaced by another one from the bot wallet — this request was not transferred
failure.dropped: The transaction left the network without being mined — nothing was transferred, the funds are still in the bot wallet. You can request again
failure.resolved_by_admin: Our team closed this request after checking on-chain that nothing was transferred

walletProfile.title: Wallet profile
walletProfile.subtitle: Your wallet address is your ID — no signup, no password to remember

walletProfile.idExplain: Everything here — your bots, credits and trade history — is tied to this address. Whoever holds this wallet owns this account, so never let anyone else reach your keys.
walletProfile.linkBody: Linking an email makes recovery easier and unlocks features that need a verified identity. Without it, everything still works through your wallet.
walletProfile.disconnectHint: Disconnects the wallet from this browser. Your data stays intact.

stability.title: TPIX Stability Reserve
stability.subtitle: A fund run by the TPIX project. It follows fixed, published rules to soften sharp TPIX price moves on TPIX DEX. Every decision and every trade is public.
stability.aiNote: All decisions come from the rules below. AI only writes the daily summary. It does not trade and does not control the price.
stability.loadError: Could not load reserve data right now. Please try again shortly.

status.offHint: The reserve is switched off. It will start only after its wallet is funded and it is switched on.

disclaimer.title: Please read
disclaimer.body: There is no price guarantee. The reserve has a limited budget, can be paused at any time, and the market can move past its band. It is run by the TPIX project, not by an independent party. This page is not investment advice.

chart.title: Price, reference and band (hourly, last 7 days)
chart.empty: The chart fills in once the reserve starts checking the market.

rules.title: The rules (current values)
rules.reference: Reference price = the average pool price over the last {days} days, sampled every minute. It follows the market slowly. It is not a fixed target.
rules.band: Band = reference ± {pct}%. Inside the band, the reserve does nothing.
rules.below: Below the band: buy TPIX with USDT, pushing back toward the lower edge and never above it.
rules.above: Above the band: sell TPIX for USDT, pushing back toward the upper edge and never below it.
rules.impact: Price impact: at most {pct}% per trade.
rules.size: Trade size: at most {usdt} USDT or {tpix} TPIX per trade (minimum {minUsdt} USDT or {minTpix} TPIX).
rules.daily: Daily limits: {usdt} USDT spent and {tpix} TPIX sold.
rules.timing: Timing: at most one trade every {minutes} minutes, and at least {hours} hours between a buy and a sell.
rules.safety: Safety stops: no action if the pool holds less than {usdt} USDT or {tpix} TPIX, if data is older than {minutes} minutes, or if price history covers less than {coverage}% of the period.
rules.slippage: Each swap sets a minimum output {bps} basis points below the expected amount.
rules.schedule: Runs every {minutes} minutes on a fixed schedule and reads only confirmed blockchain data. It never looks at pending user transactions. Days are counted in {tz}.
rules.failsafe: If a transaction fails, the reserve pauses itself until a person checks it.

wallet.title: Reserve wallet
wallet.notSet: The wallet address will be published here before the reserve is switched on.
wallet.modeDeposits: Bridge proof of reserves is not available yet, so the reserve can spend only USDT that the project deposited and recorded below.
wallet.modeBridge: Bridge proof of reserves is live. USDT_TPIX is spent only while it is fully backed.

reasons.dex_not_ready: The DEX contracts are not ready.
reasons.chain_unreadable: Could not read the blockchain, so nothing was done.
reasons.chain_stale: The chain has not produced a recent block, so nothing was done.
reasons.pool_thin: The pool is too small to trade safely, so nothing was done.
reasons.history_insufficient: Not enough price history yet for a fair reference price.
reasons.price_data_stale: Price data is too old, so nothing was done.
reasons.in_band: Price is inside the band. No action needed.
reasons.interval_wait: Too soon after the last trade. Waiting.
reasons.cooldown_opposite: Waiting out the cooldown between a buy and a sell (no wash trading).
reasons.usdt_unbacked: Bridge reserves do not fully back USDT_TPIX, so no USDT was spent.
reasons.budget_deposits_exhausted: All recorded USDT deposits are spent.
reasons.insufficient_balance: The reserve wallet has no balance of the needed token.
reasons.too_small: The allowed trade size is below the minimum, so nothing was done.
reasons.approve_needed: Allowing the router to use USDT before a buy.
reasons.below_band: Price is below the band. Buying TPIX within the limits.
reasons.above_band: Price is above the band. Selling TPIX within the limits.
reasons.not_configured: The reserve is not fully set up yet.
reasons.pending_tx: Waiting for the previous transaction to finish.
reasons.signer_unavailable: Signing is not available in this environment.
reasons.nonce_unreadable: Could not read the wallet nonce, so nothing was sent.
reasons.nonce_behind: The chain has not caught up with the last transaction yet.
reasons.sign_failed: Signing failed. The reserve paused itself.
